newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman to issue $144 mln 3-year development bonds.
newsitem.headline: Oman to issue $144 mln 3-year development bonds.

text.p: The Central Bank of Oman said on Tuesday it will issue 54.52 million rials ($144 million) worth of three-year government development bonds on Wednesday.
"The initial issue of 25 million rials had been oversubscribed," a Central Bank official told Reuters.
The subscription to the 16th issue of government development bonds had opened from May 17 to May 28.
The official said the bonds carried a coupon of 7.75 percent. Interest would be paid twice a year.
He said subscribers to the issue were Omanis and foreign Oman residents.
